labels: removal-request

This repository mirrors data from the start.gg API so that rankings built from it can be
reproduced. `users.jsonl` holds only what you made public on your start.gg profile
(tag, country/city, pronouns, linked account handles). Tournament results keep your
numeric start.gg user id, which is not removed.
